integrity: Analytical proof and a mixed symbolic, rational, and numerical checker provided; finite tests corroborate but do not replace the dimension-uniform proof. No independent audit performed.
scientific_limitations: The quartic claim concerns real labelled spherical configurations, fixed symmetric-pair first derivatives, and second-order feasibility; it is not a global minimizer or exact-design integration classification. title: Sharp quartic obstruction and two-band Hessian at cross-polytope spherical two-designs
